what_this_proves: The CORE systems claim end-to-end in REAL FlexGen: contiguous selective KV fetch is a real 2.3-3.3x decode throughput win in the offload regime, and 10x faster than FlexGens own (per-step-gather) sparse path. The efficient-contiguous-fetch insight (vs the slow gather) is validated.

honest_status.done: efficient contiguous selective fetch (sink+recency window) = StreamingLLM-in-FlexGen, correct + real throughput win. This was the HARD throughput part (FlexGen sparse failed at it).
honest_status.version: recency-window (sink+last-W) -- preserves recent-context quality but loses LONG-RANGE retrieval.
honest_status.remaining (the actual cross-layer module: attention-predicted HOT-BLOCK selection (1 export + 3 prediction + 4 refresh) to keep important early/mid tokens -> preserves long-range quality at similar throughput. De-risked: closed-loop recall 0.95 with refresh-every-4. Efficient impl = compact hot+recency to contiguous buffer at refresh (amortized), fetch contiguous on non-refresh.
